# tracer

```go
import "goliath/pkg/tracer"
```

Package tracer captures runtime call\-stack information for debugging and error diagnostics.

Unlike a module\-object style API, the entry point is a plain package\-level function:

```
frames := tracer.Trace()
```

Behavior is tuned with functional options:

```
frames := tracer.Trace(
	tracer.WithSkip(3),
	tracer.WithMaxDepth(10),
	tracer.WithFilter(func(f *runtime.Frame) bool {
		return strings.Contains(f.Function, "myapp")
	}),
)
```

<a name="Frame"></a>
## type [Frame](<https://github.com/xwinata/goliath/blob/main/pkg/tracer/tracer.go#L23-L27>)

Frame is a single stack frame with its file, line, and function name.

```go
type Frame struct {
    File     string `json:"file"`
    Line     int    `json:"line"`
    Function string `json:"function"`
}
```

<a name="Trace"></a>
### func [Trace](<https://github.com/xwinata/goliath/blob/main/pkg/tracer/tracer.go#L85>)

```go
func Trace(opts ...Option) []Frame
```

Trace captures the current call stack and returns the frames.

By default it skips Trace itself and runtime.Callers \(so the first frame is the caller of Trace\), captures up to 32 frames, and includes every frame. Use WithSkip, WithMaxDepth, and WithFilter to change this.

Each call operates on its own stack snapshot and is safe for concurrent use.

<a name="Option"></a>
## type [Option](<https://github.com/xwinata/goliath/blob/main/pkg/tracer/tracer.go#L47>)

Option customizes Trace behavior.

```go
type Option func(*config)
```

<a name="WithFilter"></a>
### func [WithFilter](<https://github.com/xwinata/goliath/blob/main/pkg/tracer/tracer.go#L72>)

```go
func WithFilter(keep func(*runtime.Frame) bool) Option
```

WithFilter keeps only frames for which keep returns true. Without a filter, all frames are captured.

<a name="WithMaxDepth"></a>
### func [WithMaxDepth](<https://github.com/xwinata/goliath/blob/main/pkg/tracer/tracer.go#L62>)

```go
func WithMaxDepth(n int) Option
```

WithMaxDepth caps the number of frames captured. Values \<= 0 keep the default.

<a name="WithSkip"></a>
### func [WithSkip](<https://github.com/xwinata/goliath/blob/main/pkg/tracer/tracer.go#L53>)

```go
func WithSkip(n int) Option
```

WithSkip sets how many leading frames to skip. Values \<= 0 keep the default, which skips Trace itself and runtime.Callers so the first frame is Trace's caller. Pass a positive value to skip additional frames \(for example, from a helper that wraps Trace\).
